top_signals.title: Asian Stocks, Bonds to Drop as Fed Hike Bets Mount: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks and bonds were poised to fall after hotter-than-expected US inflation drove losses on Wall Street and fueled bets that the Federal Reserve may hike interest rates more aggressively to tame prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
